anti_overlap: fd-emergence-systems-coherence covers whether the simulation architecture is coherent
fd-shadow-org-loop covers whether the deployment mechanic is well-designed
fd-player-psychology-onboarding covers player learning and onboarding
decision_lens: Every finding is prioritized by distance from the core loop proof: 'deployment resolves, player sees consequence, world changes.' Anything in v1 scope that doesn't contribute to this proof is scope creep risk.
focus: Whether the v1 Prometheus Crisis scope is correctly calibrated to prove the core bets without over- or under-delivering
name: fd-demo-scoping-risk
persona: A producer and lead designer who has shipped multiple early-access strategy games, specializing in identifying the minimum playable slice that validates a game's core claim. Influenced by Factorio's early-access discipline and postmortems of games that shipped too much too soon.
review_areas: Audit the gap against v1 scope — deployments don't affect simulation, activity feed shows mock data; is the described scope sufficient to close these gaps or are additional systems implied but unspecified?
Evaluate '6 core views' against the 'too many views' diagnosis — is 6 still too many for a 30-60 minute demo?
Examine the scenario content estimate (15 custom descriptions) — is this achievable without scope creep into full scenario authoring?
Check 'play in one session' against the 30-60 minute target — if emergence cascades take significant ticks, can a cold-start session reach interesting states within that window?
Assess 'pre-built agent roster' against 'agents are the game' — what minimum agent differentiation is required for the bet to be testable?
Identify what 'the app doesn't crash for 30 minutes' implies about current stability and whether a stabilization milestone is missing
success_hints: After playing, a player can articulate one thing they would do differently on a second run — the loop must produce learnable intuition
Each included v1 feature maps to a specific core bet being validated
The delta between current state and v1 requires only execution, not new design exploration
task_context: Shadow Work is a geopolitical simulation game with a Rust backend and React/Tauri UI, targeting a 'Prometheus Crisis' playable demo. PHILOSOPHY.md and VISION.md are the foundational design documents being reviewed.
